annotation.title_en: Ordinance on Type Designation of Devices (Road Vehicles)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Road Vehicles Act's type designation system for specified vehicle devices. It lists device categories (including automated driving devices, cybersecurity systems, software update systems), application procedures, quality control, marking, and recognition of UN regulation (UN ECE 1958 Agreement) approvals. Revised effective 2026-10-20.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines specified devices subject to type designation, including automated driving device, cybersecurity system and software update system.
Sets application procedure, required documents, and quality management for type designation.
Deems UN Regulation approvals (e.g., UN R155, R156, R157) as designation-equivalent for listed devices.
Requires manufacturers to inspect products for uniformity and keep results one year.
Allows ministerial recommendations and revocation for violations.
